patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; monday sales CRM is narrower/specialist.

Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; monday sales CRM is narrower/specialist. Choose monday sales CRM only if your buying job matches “Work OS–style sales CRM from monday.com for visual pipelines, automations, and team collab” rather than Salesforce's shape. Choose Salesforce only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and ” rather than monday sales CRM's shape. Workflow advantage: monday sales CRM leans shared coverage; Salesforce leans account-management, complex-sales-processes. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Salesforce documents a broader use-case set; monday sales CRM is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: monday sales CRM is Work OS–style sales CRM from monday.com for visual pipelines, automations, and team collaboration.; Salesforce is Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and mid-market teams..
- Company-size focus: monday sales CRM (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Salesforce (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: monday sales CRM-leaning — vs Salesforce-leaning account-management, complex-sales-processes, field-sales.
- Researched limits: monday sales CRM — Confirm live monday sales CRM checkout; packaging can change.; Salesforce — USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO..

Limitations — monday sales CRM: Confirm live monday sales CRM checkout; packaging can change.; Salesforce: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; Premier Support is an add-on on Pro Suite. Agentforce for Sales, Sales Programs, Revenue Intelligence, and Revenue Cloud are separate paid add-ons; some require Contact us..

Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO. · Avoid monday sales CRM if you actually need Salesforce's motion (Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across )
